title: Sydney Trivia Night

questions.q: The Sydney Opera House was designed by an architect from which country?
Sydney hosted the Summer Olympic Games in which year?
What affectionate nickname do Sydneysiders give the Harbour Bridge?
The City2Surf fun run finishes at which famous Sydney beach?
In which year did the First Fleet arrive at Sydney Cove?
What is the official name of the natural harbour better known as Sydney Harbour?
The Manly ferry leaves from which harbourside transport hub in the city centre?
Which historic precinct on the western side of Circular Quay grew up around the colony's first settlement in 1788?
Which harbourside amusement park at Milsons Point is entered through a giant smiling face?
Which AFL club, originally South Melbourne, moved to Sydney in 1982?

notes: Jørn Utzon, Danish architect, won the 1957 design competition; see sydneyoperahouse.com or Wikipedia.
Games of the XXVII Olympiad, September 2000; see olympics.com.
Long-standing nickname; see Sydney Harbour Bridge on Wikipedia or the NSW Government bridge page.
Race runs from the CBD (Hyde Park) to Bondi Beach; see city2surf.com.au.
First Fleet arrived January 1788, marked by 26 January; see National Museum of Australia.
Port Jackson is the official name of the harbour; see Port Jackson on Wikipedia or the NSW Geographical Names Board.
Manly ferry runs from Circular Quay wharf; see transportnsw.info.
The Rocks. Reworded away from 'southern end of the bridge', which fits Dawes Point.
Luna Park Sydney opened 1935 with its face entrance; see lunaparksydney.com or Wikipedia.
South Melbourne relocated to Sydney in 1982, renamed Sydney Swans; see sydneyswans.com.au or Wikipedia.
